detail.longDescription: Your cron job died with exit 137 and its log just stops. That's SIGKILL, and SIGKILL doesn't say who sent it. How to prove it was the OOM killer (and when it wasn't), why the job can't log its own death, and how to cap one job's memory: # cron # linux # sysadmin # selfhosted https:// runwisp.com/blog/cron-job-kill ed-exit-137-oom/
